resources.string: Smooth fade-in & fade-out for every track, system-wide
Volume ramps from 0 to your level at the start of each track
Volume drops to 0 near the end of each track (requires duration info from the app)
MusicFader needs Notification Access to detect track changes in Spotify, YouTube, and other music apps.
MusicFader watches media sessions to detect when a new song starts. Please enable Notification Access for MusicFader in the Settings screen that opens.
Notification permission denied – the status bar icon may not appear.

1. Grant Notification Access so MusicFader can observe media sessions from any app.

2. Enable the toggle above.

3. Play music in Spotify, YouTube Music, JioSaavn, or any other app — MusicFader auto-fades volume at the start and near the end of each track.

4. The service runs in the background and survives app switches. Use the notification actions to pause or stop it.
